spec.rawSql:
SELECT w.window_end, (date_trunc('month', w.window_end) - interval '8 months')::date AS first_month,
  (SELECT name FROM org_units WHERE id = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) AS place,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'statins' AND key = 'min_age') AS min_age
FROM report_window('${reporting_month}'::date) w
WHERE '$isAllowed' = '1'

SELECT s.*, a.eligible_n AS avg_d, a.on_statin_n AS avg_n, a.on_statin_pct AS avg_pct,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'statins' AND key = 'flag_below_pct') AS flag_below_pct, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'statins' AND key = 'min_eligible') AS min_eligible
FROM report_statins('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) s
LEFT JOIN report_statins('${reporting_month}'::date, NULL) a ON a.is_selected
WHERE s.is_selected AND '$isAllowed' = '1'

SELECT s.month_date, s.org_unit_name, s.too_few, s.eligible_n, s.on_statin_n, s.rate_pct,
  s.average_eligible_n, s.average_on_statin_n, s.average_rate_pct,
  (SELECT name FROM org_units WHERE id = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) AS place
FROM report_statins_monthly('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) s
WHERE s.is_selected AND '$isAllowed' = '1'
ORDER BY s.month_date

spec.description: Share of eligible patients with a statin on their latest prescription, at each month end. Average is all places together.
spec.title: On a statin by month

spec.rawSql:
SELECT s.month_date, s.org_unit_name, s.too_few, s.eligible_n, s.on_statin_n, s.rate_pct,
  s.average_eligible_n, s.average_on_statin_n, s.average_rate_pct,
  (SELECT name FROM org_units WHERE id = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) AS place
FROM report_statins_monthly('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) s
WHERE s.is_selected AND '$isAllowed' = '1'
ORDER BY s.month_date

spec.description: The Metabase statins table. Each month counts eligible patients at its end. The newest month is the number in the strip above.
spec.title: On a statin by month, against the average

spec.rawSql:
WITH fl AS (
  SELECT org_unit_id, json_agg(json_build_object('report', report, 'flag_reason', flag_reason, 'patients_n', patients_n)
           ORDER BY report)::text AS flags_json
  FROM report_flags('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) GROUP BY org_unit_id
)
SELECT s.*,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'statins' AND key = 'flag_below_pct') AS flag_below_pct, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'statins' AND key = 'min_eligible') AS min_eligible,
  fl.flags_json
FROM report_statins('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) s
LEFT JOIN fl ON fl.org_unit_id = s.org_unit_id
WHERE '$isAllowed' = '1'

SELECT (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'statins' AND key = 'min_age') AS min_age,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'statins' AND key = 'flag_below_pct') AS flag_below_pct
WHERE '$isAllowed' = '1'

SELECT s.level, s.org_unit_name AS place, s.not_on_statin_n,
  p.patient_id::text AS patient_id, p.patient_name, p.age, p.reason_eligible, p.last_visit_date
FROM report_statins('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) s
LEFT JOIN report_statins_patients('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) p ON '$isPatientsAllowed' = '1'
WHERE s.is_selected AND '$isAllowed' = '1'
